fields.title: Site Key
fields.help_text: The site key (public key) from your Google reCAPTCHA v2 admin panel.

fields.title: Secret Key
fields.help_text: The secret key (private key) from your Google reCAPTCHA v2 admin panel.

fields.title: Extra entries for unique visit
fields.help_text: Entries awarded to an inviter when a unique visitor clicks their invite link. Default: 1.

fields.title: Extra entries for registration after visit
fields.help_text: Entries awarded to an inviter when a visitor they referred completes registration. Default: 1.

fields.title: Verification Email Template
fields.help_text: Sent when a new participant registers and must verify their email. Placeholders are replaced when the mail is sent: {participant_email}, {giveaway_title}, {verification_link}. Put {verification_link} in a link's URL field to make a clickable button. Leave this empty to restore the example template.

fields.title: Registration Success Email Template
fields.help_text: Sent after a participant successfully verifies their email. Placeholders: {participant_email}, {giveaway_title}, {rules_url}. Note that {rules_url} is empty unless the giveaway has a rules URL set. Leave this empty to restore the example template.
